data.name: Birch
data.gender_notes: Birch is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘beorc’ meaning bright or shining one. Historically associated with the dedication of churches to the Virgin Mary, or to St. Birgitta of Sweden. In nature, the birch tree represents new beginnings and renewal. The name Birch carries the meaning “Bright, shining one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Birch usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Birch belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bright, shining one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Birch total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
